Outages
Outages
No electricity?

Check our outage map to see if we are aware of the outage or if it is part of a planned interruption. You can also give us a call on 13 10 93.

If we’re aware of an electricity outage you may hear a pre-recorded message with more information about the outage when you call us. If you need more information stay on the line to speak with one of our Contact Centre team members. Please be patient during large outages as our Contact Centre can become very busy with calls. 

If other appliances in your home are working or it looks like your neighbours have power there may be a problem inside your home. You may need to check your trip switches or fuses.

See our tips for what to do during a power outage or learn what to do if you rely on life support equipment. 

Across Canberra there are currently 3 outages affecting 155 customers.
